answer: Proof of Personhood protocols serve as a vital beacon in decentralized AI ecosystems by tethering digital identity to unique biological traits. This mechanism forces each agent to prove human association, preventing a plume of Sybil identities from saturating the network. Attackers face an insurmountable cost, as fabricating millions of verified humans is economically prohibitive, much like trying to command a zephyr to stop moving; the barrier remains rooted in the scarcity of verified human signatures.
